sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Sales of Maternity and Infant Care Commodities

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Common Law based on English law, local statutes, and customary land law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Samoa-Australia Double Taxation Agreement (signed 2008, in force 2009)
Samoa-New Zealand Double Taxation Agreement (signed 2009, in force 2010)
China-Samoa Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 1999, in force 2000)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended) and its SIFA Regulations; Samoa International Companies Act 1987, s. 54A (Register of Significant Owners); Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) directives on UBO due diligence.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport of each shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Samoa is not a Hague Apostille Convention member; documents must be fully consularized)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address of each ultimate beneficial owner (utility bill or bank statement)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public after verifying original documents

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of any legal entity shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or equivalent corporate registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization or Apostille acceptable if the shareholder's country of origin is a Hague member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate organizational chart and UBO declaration form (SIFA Form UBO-1)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Samoa International Company registered agent, signed by the applicant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization not required if executed before the registered agent

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, beneficial owners, directors, and authorized signatories against the Samoa FIU domestic sanctions list, UN Security Council consolidated list, OFAC SDN list, and PEP databases; screening performed by the licensed registered agent at onboarding and continuously thereafter.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) online name reservation portal (via https://www.sifa.ws); coordinated with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) company registry for domestic name conflict checks.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in a Roman-character form; if the desired name is in a non-Roman script, an English transliteration must be filed and the foreign script version may be included parenthetically. The name must not be misleading, obscene, or likely to deceive.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If name clearance is refused, the applicant (through its licensed registered agent) may file a written appeal to the Registrar of International Companies within 14 days of written rejection. The appeal must cite grounds of distinctiveness and may include evidence of mandatory municipal board consent for sensitive tokens. The Registrar must decide within 21 days; a 30-day extension of the reserved name is available upon payment of the statutory extension fee and demonstrating an ongoing incorporation purpose.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted to satisfy the statutory registered office requirement for a Samoa International Company. A physical registered office in Samoa, staffed by the licensed registered agent, is mandatory. A virtual office may be used for correspondence only and does not replace the statutory physical office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated 5% per annum probability of an unannounced visit by SIFA or the Registrar; probability rises to approximately 10% where e-commerce consumer data is handled, though any physical inspection is generally conducted with prior notice unless a court warrant is obtained).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and reservation fee (SIFA online) for one proposed name
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under SIFA International Companies Fee Schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Incorporation filing fee for an International Company with standard authorized capital
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under SIFA International Companies Fee Schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office service fee (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Samoa International Company registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per licensed registered agent, annually renewable

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT UBO verification and PEP/sanctions screening fee (per beneficial owner, first onboarding)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark reflecting Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 compliance obligations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization of beneficial owner and shareholder passport copies and proof of address (batch of 3 individuals)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public in country of origin + Samoan High Commission/Consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notarial tariff and consular schedule for legalization services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translation of corporate chart or non-English documents (if required)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified translator in Samoa or country of origin

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Courier and administrative handling of original clearances and legalized documents to Samoa registered agent

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended), ss. 5-12 (incorporation), s. 23 (registered office), ss. 38-42 (directors and officers)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form 1), accompanied by Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; initial share capital is fixed by the subscriber in the Memorandum and Articles; no escrow account requirement under Samoa law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) that the allotment and issuance of the initial subscribed capital of 100 ordinary shares at par value USD 1.00 be approved. (2) that the registered office of the Company be established at the office of the Licensed Registered Agent, Apia, Samoa, as notified to the Registrar of International Companies. (3) that the following officers be appointed to hold office until the next Annual General Meeting: President/Managing Director, Corporate Secretary, and Treasurer; each executive is vested with power to execute agreements, open accounts, and engage payment processors. (4) that the company seal be adopted and the officers are instructed to effect all statutory filings required to govern online retail sales of maternity and infant care supplies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL Online Portal (or physical registry, Apia, Samoa)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request for a proposed company name containing 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' as prescribed by the International Companies Act. Conduct a conflict search against the register; a granted reservation is valid for 90 days and must be cited at incorporation.
required_dossiers: Copy of passport / national ID of subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused or reserved by another applicant, file up to three alternative names within 5 working days; the registry will allocate the first available name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent (under MCIL licensing) and Notary Public / Commissioner of Oaths, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, specifying share classes, par value, director powers and indemnity provisions. The subscriber(s) and initial directors execute the documents before a notary or Commissioner of Oaths; the Registered Agent certifies true copies.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (two notarized copies)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar returns the documents for correction, revise the relevant clauses and re-execute the amended pages within 7 working days; no additional fee is charged for minor amendments.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Application for Incorporation and Payment of Statutory Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form 1 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company) together with the certified Memorandum and Articles, name reservation certificate, and the prescribed filing fee. Payment may be made by wire transfer to the Government of Samoa trust account or at the registry cashier; maintain proof of payment.
required_dossiers: Form 1 application (signed by subscriber and registered agent)
Two notarized copies of Memorandum and Articles of Association
Registered agent consent and appointment letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried or payment is rejected, correct the defect or provide the registry with an updated payment receipt within 7 days; failure to cure within 30 days requires a fresh filing with a new fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Registered Office Notification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues a Certificate of Incorporation under the Seal of Samoa. The registered agent files Form 3 to formally notify the registered office address in Samoa if not already stated in the Memorandum; the certificate and notified address enter the public register.
required_dossiers: Consent of registered office holder (licensed agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered office address is recorded inaccurately, file Form 4 (Change of Registered Office) within 14 days; the amendment takes effect on filing and is binding without court order.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Officers and Adoption of First Board Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors (internal corporate act) and Company Secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting, adopt the pro-forma first board resolution, appoint the President/Managing Director, Secretary, and Treasurer, and approve the opening of corporate bank accounts and payment processor engagements. Maintain the minutes in the company's corporate records register.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an officer's consent form is invalid or unsigned, obtain a corrected consent and ratify by a subsequent board resolution within 5 working days; no filing with the Registrar is required for officer changes under Samoa IC law.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) – Business Licence Office

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment and Conservation Division, Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration / Exempt – low-impact warehouse and online retail operation under the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004; no full EIA required for existing commercial premises used for e-commerce fulfillment.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater from sanitary facilities must be discharged into an approved municipal sewer or compliant septic system pursuant to the Water Resources Management Act 2008; no industrial VOCs or hazardous emissions generated; packaging waste must be segregated and recycled under the Waste Management Regulations; noise and fugitive dust must not exceed MNRE ambient guidelines for commercial zones.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate issued by Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority under the Fire Safety Act; structural load inspection for storage racks and shelving in fulfillment areas; workplace registration and occupational health clearance from the Occupational Safety and Health Division, MCIL, under the Occupational Safety and Health Act 2002, including first-aid, evacuation, and manual handling protocols.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Revenue (MaF – Malo o Tupe), Apia, Samoa; official portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws; customs processing is coordinated through the same Ministry via the ASYCUDA World clearance platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Samoa International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987 obtains its statutory Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) through the Ministry of Revenue taxpayer registration process. The IC's licensed registered agent submits Form TR-1 together with: (i) the Certificate of Incorporation; (ii) the Memorandum and Articles of Association; (iii) the offshore tax exemption certificate or ICA status letter issued by the Registrar of International Companies; (iv) director and shareholder particulars; (v) registered agent consent; and (vi) a board resolution authorizing the registration. The Ministry issues the TIN within 5–10 business days. No minimum capital, local director, or residency condition applies to an IC. The same TIN is used for VAGST participation if the IC elects to register as a taxable person.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone – The Samoa International Company is statutorily tax-exempt: no Samoa income tax, corporate income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax on distributions, or stamp duty applies to its offshore business. Exemption is automatic upon incorporation and may be evidenced by a tax exemption certificate issued under the International Companies Act 1987.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch classification elections exist under Samoa domestic law; the IC's tax-exempt status is mandatory and non-elective. The only statutory conversion routes are: (a) re-domiciliation of a foreign company into Samoa as an IC; (b) conversion of an IC into a domestic Samoa company, which subjects it to the ordinary corporate income tax and VAGST regime; and (c) limited-life company elections available under the International Companies Act. Foreign shareholders must make any upstream entity classification elections in their home jurisdiction (e.g., US check-the-box), but such elections do not alter the IC's Samoa classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax) – Samoa's national consumption tax administered under the VAGST Act 2013 and the Tax Administration Act 2012.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 60,000 – compulsory VAGST registration threshold based on the value of taxable supplies (other than capital supplies) made in any 12-month period. An IC with exclusively zero-rated export turnover may nonetheless register for VAGST to recover input tax credits, while an IC with no taxable activity in Samoa has no registration obligation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa imposes no real-time e-invoicing, fiscal clearance, API, or digital stamping mandate. Monthly VAGST returns are filed electronically through the Ministry of Revenue E-Services portal. VAGST invoices must state the supplier's name and VAGST registration number, customer identity, invoice date, description, quantity, taxable value, and VAGST amount. Export clearances are processed electronically through the ASYCUDA World customs declaration system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under the VAGST Act 2013, a Samoan vendor supplying online maternity and infant-care commodities (ISIC 4791 / NAICS 458110) applies the 0% rate where title passes to a non-resident purchaser and the goods are physically removed from Samoa within 28 days (or an approved extension) of the time of supply. Services qualify for 0% where the recipient is outside Samoa at the time of supply and the benefit is consumed outside Samoa. The seller must hold contemporaneous evidence of export and payment settlement. The Samoa IC's offshore income is separately exempt from income tax under the International Companies Act 1987, making the principal VAGST objective recovery of input credits on eligible business expenses.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World electronic export declaration with export entry number)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill showing Samoa port/airport of departure and a consignee outside Samoa
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by a Samoa licensed bank evidencing receipt of export proceeds in foreign currency
Commercial invoice and packing list cross-referenced to the customs declaration
Sales contract, purchase order, or e-commerce platform settlement statement identifying the non-resident buyer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Ministry of Revenue and the Customs Division conduct post-clearance audits of zero-rated export claims. Deficient or fraudulent substantiation triggers: (i) reversal of input credits and reassessment of output VAGST at the statutory 15% rate with interest from the due date; (ii) a civil penalty of up to 150% of the tax evaded under the Tax Administration Act 2012; (iii) criminal prosecution of the IC and responsible directors, with fines up to WST 100,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 5 years; and (iv) customs forfeiture and contravention penalties for false or incomplete export declarations. The retrospective reassessment window is generally 5 years, extended where fraud or wilful default is established.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala is not a fully convertible offshore currency; current account payments for goods and services are generally free from exchange control and settle freely through authorised dealers, while capital account inflows and outflows (including equity subscriptions, loans and profit repatriation) are subject to prior CBS approval or post-transaction notification. Profit remittance is permitted through an authorised dealer in WST or foreign currency, conditioned on audited financial statements, tax clearance, satisfaction of the 15% resident withholding tax (or reduced treaty rate), and confirmation of the International Company's tax exemption status under the International Companies Act 1987.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exporters must repatriate export proceeds into Samoa within 30 days from the date of shipment and deposit them in a Samoa-based bank account; a mandatory conversion ratio is not statutorily fixed, but proceeds must be offered for conversion to WST or retained as approved foreign currency with an authorised dealer, and any exemption requires advance CBS documentation.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low. Samoa's legal framework does not recognise foreign digital e-money institutions (EMIs) as regulated entities for treasury clearing; a non-resident EMI may not open a correspondent account or issue digital payment instruments without a licensing and permanent establishment analysis. Such EMIs may only be used as a payment aggregator at the upstream e-commerce gateway level, while all WST-clearing and foreign exchange settlements must be executed through a Samoa licensed commercial bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: First-time account opening for an International Company with non-resident directors generally requires physical attendance before a designated bank officer; fully remote statutory opening is rarely available. Where the corporate is introduced by a licensed Samoa trustee or Caribbean/Asia-Pacific correspondent law firm, a videoconference interview may be accepted together with certified passport and board resolution, but this remains discretionary and requires a formal policy exception.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore International Company presenting no evident trading substance or fixed professional nexus to Samoa.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered office certificate and registered agent letter, board resolutions authorising the account, initial and projected financial statements, commercial contracts / supplier purchase orders, evidence of physical operations in the e-commerce business (warehouse or fulfilment location), CVs or profiles of the underlying customer-facing management, and a statement of consistency between the tax-exempt vehicle and the commercial model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business name or merchant description containing terms suggestive of charity, donation or aid rather than a commercial baby and maternity product retailer.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Municipal or trade registry extract confirming ISIC 4791 online retail classification, product inventory and pricing list, supplier invoice and vendor due diligence, website screenshots describing goods for sale, payment gateway (Stripe / PayPal) verification documents, trademark or trade-name application, and a statutory declaration of commercial purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency cross-border movement from multiple foreign jurisdictions using fintech aggregators into a low-activity Samoan IC bank account.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 12-month treasury ledger and payment gateway reconciliation, end-customer sales invoices and shipping records, source-of-funds statements and bank references for each remitter, Customs records for trade flows, tax clearance certificates, and a written treasury policy confirming that funds pass through one licensed Samoan account before disbursement to suppliers.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Wire transfers must be sent via SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's bank to the IC's account at a Samoan authorised dealer. For a non-resident shareholder, the transfer must identify the beneficiary account as 'Capital Escrow / Ops' and state 'Capital contribution and share subscription' in the payment details; simultaneously the company must submit the board and shareholder written resolution, share allotment form, source of wealth and source of funds statements, and a certificate of good standing. If the gross capital injection equals or exceeds CBS notification thresholds, the receiving bank will file the appropriate balance-of-payments and exchange-control declaration; any intra-group loan must be supported by a written loan agreement with arm's length interest rate and be included in the CBS foreign investment registration file.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound supplier payments should be executed through (a) SWIFT MT103 for open-account trade settlements up to the bank's delegated limit, and (b) a Documentary or Commercial Letter of Credit issued by the Samoan negotiating bank for large or initial supplier transactions, with confirmed or unconfirmed status depending on the supplier's jurisdiction. Each disbursement must be supported by the commercial invoice, packing list, air waybill or bill of lading, Customs export declaration (where applicable), and beneficial ownership disclosure; the bank will apply the prevailing WST/USD or WST settlement rate and withhold any applicable transaction charges or exchange gain charges.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Spot FX purchases and sales through a Samoa licensed authorised dealer
Outright forward foreign exchange contracts with trade documentation and a maturity not exceeding 12 months
Cross-currency swaps with prior Central Bank of Samoa no-objection approval
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) only on a case-by-case basis with formal CBS authorisation; no established onshore NDF market exists

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Annual License Fee Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Companies Office, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing due on each anniversary of incorporation; a grace period of 30 days after the anniversary date is permitted without late penalty
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of up to 100% of the annual fee accrues after the grace period; continued non-payment may result in administrative strike-off from the International Companies Register after 90 days of default, subject to restoration procedures

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit is imposed on a tax-exempt Samoa International Company solely by reason of size or turnover; an audit may be required by shareholder resolution, court order, or a directive from the Registrar under the International Companies Act 1987 as amended
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) or another internationally recognized accounting framework acceptable to the registered agent and Samoa Revenue; no filed audited financial statements are required for tax-exempt International Companies unless the Registrar directs otherwise

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must maintain a current register of beneficial owners and confirm its accuracy at least annually and whenever there is any transfer of shares; changes in significant shareholding are reported to the registered agent, who files an updated UBO record with the International Companies Office where required under Samoa's AML/CFT regime

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,200 to USD 3,500 per annum if commercially procured on a voluntary basis; no recurring audit fee is mandated by law

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Company exemption from Samoa income tax, withholding tax, and stamp duty under the International Companies Act 1987; ordinary Samoan resident companies are taxed at 25% and may claim allowable business deductions and tax accounting elections.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return (Form IC-AR) filed through the Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour / Office of the Registrar of International Companies. No corporate income tax return is required for an exempt International Company.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 28 days after the anniversary of the certificate of incorporation; registration renewal is tied to payment of the annual Government fee before the anniversary date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part 1 – Company Name and Registered Office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enter the exact official name, company number, registered office physical address in Samoa, and postal address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For non-resident shareholders, the registered office of the licensed Samoan agent must be used as the service address; foreign addresses of directors may appear in the register of directors.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Provide the name and license number of the Samoan registered agent and the date of the agent’s appointment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent’s consent must be current; a change of agent requires filing of a notice of change within 14 days.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: List the number of issued shares, classes of shares, amount paid up, and all shareholder names.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Bearer shares are abolished; beneficial ownership of any non-resident shareholder must be declared to the registered agent for AML purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: List the names, addresses, nationalities, and dates of appointment of directors and the secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The register may contain natural or corporate directors; corporate directors resident outside Samoa must name a natural person for service of process if required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC is not a resident of Samoa and has not carried on business inside Samoa except in accordance with the International Companies Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This declaration preserves tax exemption; if the entity trades electronically from Samoa or exercises central management in Samoa, the declaration cannot be made and the entity may become subject to ordinary taxation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the Annual Return incurs a USD 100 penalty and a further USD 10 per day of default (maximum USD 500); non-payment of the annual Government fee results in automatic restoration proceedings or strike-off. After strike-off, the liability of directors and members continues for 20 years under the Companies Act.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for International Company distributions under the International Companies Act 1987; the general Samoa dividend withholding tax for ordinary resident companies is 15%.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: An IC pays no Samoa dividend WHT, so treaty relief is unnecessary. For non-exempt companies, the protocol is: (i) obtain a Samoa tax residence certificate from the Ministry of Revenue (if treaty resident), (ii) complete IRD Form WHT-01 and attach the certificate for each distribution, and (iii) apply the applicable DTA dividend rate before payment. Samoa DTA rates typically reduce dividends to 15%, with 5% where the beneficial owner is a company controlling at least 25% of the voting power.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: For an IC, statutory withholding on royalty and interest payments to offshore owners is 0%. For ordinary resident companies, Samoa imposes 15% on royalties and 15% on interest; DTA-protected residents may obtain a 10% treaty rate under Samoa’s tax treaties with New Zealand, Australia, and other treaty partners.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: WST 250,000 aggregate annual related-party transactions trigger Local File preparation; Master File is required where the ultimate group’s turnover is above WST 100 million. An e-commerce IC must also prepare contemporaneous TP documentation if its intra-group cross-border sales exceed WST 150,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoan ESR (international exchange of information laws and economic substance regulations) require any IC engaged in 'distribution and service centre' activity to prove substantive economic presence: physical office in Samoa, at least one board meeting per year in Samoa, payroll generated for local employees, and core income-generating activities performed in Samoa. Offshore-only management is not sufficient; failure to meet the test triggers administrative penalties, information exchange to the foreign tax authority, and possible deregistration.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Exemption Abuse / De Facto Residence
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC is managed and controlled from Hong Kong or a mainland Chinese jurisdiction through online marketplaces while continuing to claim Samoan exemption; all e-commerce contracts are concluded abroad and no Samoan board decision is made.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reassessment as a resident company at 25% corporate income tax on worldwide income, interest and penalty of up to 100% of the tax shortfall, and late payment surcharge of 2% per month under the Samoa Revenue Administration Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors individually liable for the unpaid tax when the IC is treated as a sham; travel bans are available to Revenue for non-cooperation, and directors may face a custodial sentence of up to 7 years for wilful evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a shelf IC with no office, no employees, no record of meetings, and having the entire distribution function performed by a related party in the beneficial owner’s jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR financial penalty up to WST 20,000 per year of non-compliance, additional fixed civil penalty of WST 5,000 per infraction, and referral to the Registrar for strike-off; the IC’s license may also be revoked.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The Registrar may disqualify directors from managing any Samoa company for up to 5 years; directors of the registered agent can be personally sanctioned for mis-certifying substance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / KYC Deficiencies in E-Commerce Rails
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting Stripe and PayPal payments from customers internationally without conducting any customer due diligence, retaining no transaction records, and failing to appoint an AML compliance officer for the e-commerce cash flow.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine of up to WST 100,000 for the company and WST 15,000 for each culpable officer under the Samoa Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Act; summary suspension of the registered agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face criminal prosecution, imprisonment for up to 5 years, and a personal demerit record that prohibits future directorship in regulated businesses.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Setting an artificially low resale price to the offshore affiliate to shift profits out of Samoa while the IC bears no financial risk; or conversely inflating management fees to zero-tax IC to strip taxable profit from a foreign related enterprise.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: An arm’s length adjustment is mandatory; the tax authority imposes a 30% adjustment penalty on the recomputed taxable income and may require redocumentation at the IC’s cost.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed inaccurate TP documentation are jointly and severally liable for the additional tax and penalties; where the entity is struck off, personal liability extends to unpaid tax debts up to the amount of the distribution.
